title: Integral block finiteness over a fixed complete valuation ring
exact_target: Fix a prime p, a complete characteristic-zero discrete valuation ring O with algebraically closed residue field of characteristic p, and $M\geq 1$. Are there only finitely many O-linear Morita classes of finite-group block orders OGb whose residue defect groups have order at most M?
